ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-ratio of approximately 18:1 (low-intensity to high-intensity pixels) across the visible ventral fluke area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer boundaries exhibit a convex curve from the central axis to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear white-to-light-grey pixel disruptions detected on the mid-ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregular tissue loss (notch) on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe; heavy white scar tissue/pigmentation concentrated at the apex of the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique high-contrast white margin at the extreme distal end of the right lobe trailing edge.
